Our Heritage

A trusted name in agricultural exports, connecting India's rich agricultural heritage with global markets.

The Kartari Legacy

Founded in 2025 by visionary entrepreneurs Saurabh and Sanjay, Kartari Exim represents the pinnacle of agricultural export excellence. With 25 years of combined expertise in international trade, our founders recognized the untapped potential of India's agricultural heritage.

Our commitment to quality, sustainability, and customer satisfaction has made us a preferred partner for businesses worldwide. We work directly with farmers and cooperatives to ensure ethical sourcing and the highest standards of quality control. Every grain tells a story, every spice carries tradition.

From traditional spices to modern organic products, we carry forward India's agricultural legacy while embracing innovation and sustainable practices with an unwavering commitment to quality.

The Kartari Advantage

We are a Pune-based agricultural exporter with 15 years of combined expertise — supplying verified quality, reliable documentation, and competitive pricing to buyers worldwide.

Consistent Quality

Every shipment is lab-tested and graded before dispatch. What you see in the sample is what arrives in the container — every time.

APEDA Registered Exporter

Fully registered with APEDA and compliant with international export standards. We provide COO, phytosanitary certificates, and COA with every shipment.

Fast Quote Turnaround

Send us your requirement and get a detailed quote within 24 hours. We have offices in both India and UAE to serve buyers across time zones.

Exporting to 10+ Countries

Active supply relationships with buyers across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, East Africa, and South Asia — built on repeat orders and trust.

Direct Farm Sourcing

We work directly with farmers and processors across India — cutting out middlemen to give you better pricing and traceable supply chains.

End-to-End Export Handling

We manage everything from procurement and quality checks to packaging, documentation, and container loading at Nhava Sheva port and Mundra port.
